title: Integrations
honestStatus: Only the local test adapter is exercised in this release. No connector here is connected to a Mobily system; a connector is "Verified" only after a test run succeeds on its current configuration.
readOnly: You can view this but not change it.

table.sortNote: Sorting applies to the rows on this page.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.intro: Connectors bring data from a source system into staged imports. Each run is recorded with its counts, errors and retries.
connectors.emptyBody: A technical administrator can add a connector. Until then, enter KPI actuals by form or import a file.

connector.title: Connector
connector.subtitle: Connector {{code}}
connector.testStarted: The test run is recorded. Its result appears in the run history.
connector.testSucceeded: The test run succeeded: the connector is verified for this configuration version.
connector.testFailed: The test run failed: the connector stays not verified. See the error below.
connector.runQueued: The run is queued. Its result appears in the run history.
connector.enabled: The connector is enabled. Enabling does not verify it: run a test.
connector.disabled: The connector is disabled. Forms and imports keep working.
connector.enableBody: Scheduled and manual runs can start again. The connector stays "Not verified" until a test run succeeds.
connector.disableBody: Queued runs are cancelled. KPI forms and file imports keep working.

verification.hint: Verified only after a test run succeeds on the current configuration.

commitMode.manual: Staged for a person to commit
commitMode.auto: Committed automatically on behalf of a named user

credentials.title: Credential references
credentials.hint: Credentials are references to a secret that IT holds (provider and name). The secret itself is never entered, stored or shown here.

form.intro: A configuration change creates a new configuration version; the connector is "Not verified" again until a test run succeeds on it.
form.fixedAfterCreate: Fixed when the connector is created.
form.codeHint: 2 to 63 characters: lower-case letters, digits, hyphen and underscore, starting with a letter.
form.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 63 lower-case letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter.
form.adapterHint: The local test adapter is the only adapter exercised in this release.
form.adapterModeHint: Healthy returns the fixture rows; Failing and Stopped make runs fail, to show the actionable error.
form.adapterConfirmHint: Whether the test adapter confirms an outbound write. "Never" leaves writes pending confirmation.
form.sourceSystemIdHint: The source system's own identifier, recorded with every run and confirmation.
form.sourceSystemIdInvalid: Enter the source system ID: letters, digits and . _ : / - only, starting with a letter or digit.
form.commitModeHint: Only a machine source may commit automatically, on behalf of a named user who may submit actuals.
form.commitOnBehalfOfHint: The ID of the user the automatic commit acts for.
form.credentialInvalid: Enter a purpose, a provider (lower-case letters, digits, underscore) and a secret name; each purpose once.
form.outboundStatusPush: Allow the deliverable status push (outbound write, test adapter only)

mappings.title: Field mappings
mappings.intro: Each source column maps to one field of the import template.
mappings.newVersionNote: Saving creates a new configuration version; run a test afterwards to verify it.
mappings.saved: The mappings are saved as a new configuration version.
mappings.sourceRequired: Enter the source column (at most 100 characters).
mappings.targetTwice: Each target field can be mapped once.

runs.title: Run history
runs.intro: Newest first. A count that is not known yet is shown as Unknown, never 0.
runs.emptyBody: Run a test or run the connector now to record a run.

actionable.title: The newest run failed
actionable.fallbackIntro: Core work does not depend on the connector. Meanwhile:

fallback.kpi_form: Enter the KPI actual by form

actionable.unknownWhy: The run failed for a reason this screen does not know.
actionable.unknownTodo: Ask a technical administrator to look at the run; meanwhile enter the values by form or import a file.

connector__source_unavailable.why: The source system did not respond.
connector__source_unavailable.todo: Retry the run later. Until the source is back, enter the values by form or import a file.

connector__stopped.why: The connector's test adapter is stopped.
connector__stopped.todo: Start the adapter (set its mode to healthy), or enter the values by form or import a file.

connector__credentials_rejected.why: The source system rejected the connector's credentials.
connector__credentials_rejected.todo: Ask IT to renew the secret named in the connector's credential reference, then retry.

connector__secret_unresolvable.why: The secret reference {{name}} could not be resolved.
connector__secret_unresolvable.todo: Ask IT to provide the secret {{name}} to the application's secret provider, then retry.
connector__secret_unresolvable.why_noParams: A secret reference of the connector could not be resolved.
connector__secret_unresolvable.todo_noParams: Ask IT to provide the connector's secret to the application's secret provider, then retry.

connector__mapping_mismatch.why: The source did not provide the mapped column {{column}}.
connector__mapping_mismatch.todo: Update the field mappings to match the source, then retry.
connector__mapping_mismatch.why_noParams: The source did not provide a mapped column.

connector__response_invalid.why: The source returned data the connector cannot read.
connector__response_invalid.todo: Check the source export with its owner; meanwhile enter the values by form or import a file.

webhooks.title: Webhook endpoints
webhooks.intro: An endpoint receives signed deliveries for a webhook connector and stages each one as an import. An unsigned or wrongly signed call is rejected.
webhooks.secretNote: The signing secret is a reference that IT provisions. Its value is never entered, stored or shown here.
webhooks.emptyBody: A technical administrator can create one for a webhook connector.
webhooks.label: Label
webhooks.signatureNote: Each call carries X-MTH-Webhook-Timestamp, X-MTH-Webhook-Delivery and X-MTH-Webhook-Signature (v1, HMAC-SHA256), as documented in the API description.
webhooks.secretRefHint: The provider and name of the secret IT has provisioned, e.g. env and WEBHOOK_SECRET.
webhooks.noWebhookConnector: No webhook connector exists in this organization yet.
webhooks.rotateIntro: The previous secret stays valid for the grace period, so the sender can switch without lost deliveries.
webhooks.rotatedNotice: The signing secret reference is rotated.
webhooks.disableBody: Disabling is final: every later call to this address is rejected.

outbound.title: Outbound writes
outbound.intro: Connector-defined writes to a downstream system. A write is done only on a confirmed response; until then it is pending confirmation.
outbound.noManualConfirmation: There is no manual confirmation: "Check confirmation" asks the adapter for the outcome of the write's idempotency key, without a second effect.
outbound.emptyBody: Writes appear here when a transformation director executes a connector-defined action.

checked.pending_confirmation: The adapter has not confirmed the write: it stays pending confirmation.
checked.failed: The adapter reported the write as failed.
